canonical_waveform.authority: Canonical valid 3-second waveform already used by the accepted uploaded-waveform route.

interval.start: Canonical valid waveform resident in h1UploadedWaveform, request ready, before ordinary run-state setup and runOnce waveform CRC.
interval.end: Ordinary result saved in gLastResult and ResultReady recorded; before USB/UART serialization/output.
excluded: Model hash verification performed only at initialization

acceptance.raw_format: uint64 cycle delta plus bound uint32 frequency; retain unrounded rational values
acceptance.retention: preallocated RAM; all samples emitted after campaign
acceptance.comparison: cycles * 1000 < 700 * clock_hz using exact integer/rational comparison; never rounded microseconds

statistics.count: 100 measured latency samples; warmups excluded from measured statistics.
statistics.mean_ms: Arithmetic mean of all measured samples.
statistics.median_ms: Mean of the 50th and 51st samples in ascending order.
statistics.p95_ms: Nearest-rank percentile: ceil(0.95 * count), the 95th ascending sample for count 100.
statistics.population_standard_deviation_ms: Square root of sum((sample - mean)^2) / count; denominator 100.

acceptance.disposition_scope: baseline observation only; never future final acceptance pass

diagnostic.unassigned_overhead: retain explicit reconciliation/residual; do not attribute unmeasured overhead to arithmetic

stage_formulas.1: sum of complete four-frame spectral group elapsed cycles, excluding mel
stage_formulas.2: existing compact mel group elapsed sum, including ordinary finite checks
stage_formulas.3: frontend elapsed - stage1 - stage2 + backbone quantization elapsed; existing frontend output CRC included
stage_formulas.4: backbone command B - backbone quantization end; includes per-run model lifecycle, tensor allocation/copy and pre-submit cache
stage_formulas.5: backbone earliest IRQ C - command B
stage_formulas.6: GeM start - backbone IRQ C; completion, guards, output copy and lease
stage_formulas.8: exact bridge end - exact bridge start
stage_formulas.9: classifier command B - bridge end; lifecycle/input copy/pre-submit cache
stage_formulas.11: primary end - classifier IRQ C; completion/guards/output copy/postprocess/ordinary CRC/report publication

diagnostic.auxiliary_residual: Retain total - sum(stages1..11), including waveform CRC/setup and unassigned bookkeeping; report separately in stage-contribution/ranking table. Do not hide or attribute it to arithmetic.

timing_source_strategy.source: k_cycle_get_64 -> sys_clock_cycle_get_64 -> uint64 SysTick extension under spinlock
timing_source_strategy.frequency_basis: current generated config and matching pinned board/timer source; fresh build and physical preflight must confirm, not historical timing

wrap.software_extension_assumption: no multiple unobserved SysTick wraps while interrupts and readers are prevented; retain normal interrupts; do not disable IRQs across inference

timing_source_strategy.monotonic_validation: prospectively validate preflight timestamp ordering, matching frequency and enabled clock source outside H1 performance measurement; stop on invalid source

combine: actual driver cache callbacks and guard operations
transfer_ledger.whole_cache_bytes: actual target D-cache capacity from CCSIDR; never call requested scratch tensor size the amount of a whole-cache maintenance
transfer_ledger.range_bytes: both raw request and cache-line-rounded address/span
transfer_ledger.cpu_copies: model/container copies + tensor copies + ordinary result metadata, separated from numerical writes and bitcasts
transfer_ledger.frontend_traffic: source-level logical tensor passes; distinguish complete buffer publications and explicit reads/writes from internal FFT reuse/physical bus traffic; preserve any unresolved component
transfer_ledger.cache_ordering: Observe actual timestamps around unchanged callbacks; pinned invalidation loop precedes semaphore wait and its order relative to IRQ must be measured.
